title: cairn test --exec runs the command in the caller's cwd
intention: `cairn test --exec` runs its command in the directory the caller stood in: bin/cmd/test carries $PWD across its `cd "$REPO"` as CAIRN_TESTER_CALLER_CWD, and the --exec dispatch hands it to run_exec as the default cwd (an explicit cwd= still wins). Proof-path runs keep their repo-relative resolution.
why: The sealed exec (2c9eeab2da87) is the one door the verdict (68cef2ddd8ef) and CC's tool calls are rewritten onto, as a drop-in for bare `bash -c`. It silently ran every command at the repo root, so 68cef2ddd8ef's sibling proof test_the_instrument_is_run.py reds 127 ('bash: proofs/exits.sh: No such file or directory') with a correct verdict build: an instrument written relative to where it is run cannot be trusted through the door.
traces_to: Law 8 and the isolation family under dda0e72b9c67 (the door must be a faithful drop-in, or the instruments rewritten onto it measure the wrong tree); RULE 1 (the fix lands at the tester's own address, not inside the verdict).
how: bin/cmd/test: `export CAIRN_TESTER_CALLER_CWD="$PWD"` immediately before `cd "$REPO"`. cairn/devices/tester/cli.py --exec dispatch: run_exec(..., cwd=os.environ.get("CAIRN_TESTER_CALLER_CWD") or None). device.py unchanged. Red-first proof cairn/devices/tester/proofs/test_exec_runs_in_the_callers_cwd.py, teeth: test_exec_from_another_dir_runs_there (1), test_an_explicit_cwd_still_wins (2), test_a_proof_path_run_still_resolves_from_the_repo (3).
falsifier: Done when cairn/devices/tester/proofs/test_exec_runs_in_the_callers_cwd.py is green under bin/cairn test: (1) `bin/cairn test --exec pwd` run with cwd=<a mktemp dir> prints that dir (red at HEAD b887549e: prints the repo root); (2) TesterDevice().run_exec('pwd', cwd=<dir B>) driven in a child interpreter with CAIRN_TESTER_CALLER_CWD=<dir A> prints dir B, so an explicit cwd still wins; (3) `bin/cairn test cairn/devices/tester/proofs/fixtures/green_proof.py` run with cwd=<a mktemp dir> still finds and runs that proof (repo-relative proof-path resolution untouched). And 68cef2ddd8ef's test_the_instrument_is_run.py goes green with its applied build unchanged. Horizon: this voyage. Wrong intent if a measured --exec caller relies on running at the repo root from elsewhere.
watchme: none, because the first live use is ticket 68cef2ddd8ef's sibling proof cairn/devices/codemother/machines/verdict/proofs/test_the_instrument_is_run.py, which runs instruments with cwd=<tempdir> through --exec and reds 127 if the cwd is lost
